name: KGEvidence
title: Knowledge graph L1: Evidence
description: One row of an evidence profile: the evidence for one outcome of one key question, with its certainty (handbook §9.2). Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/evidence.

element.definition: One row of an evidence profile: the evidence for one outcome of one key question, with its certainty (handbook §9.2). Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/evidence.
Which kind of evidence a row is, and so which scale its certainty is on: GRADE for effects, GRADE-CERQual for qualitative findings.
Summary of the body of evidence.
Number of studies in the body of evidence.
Bibliographic citation of the evidence review.
